datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Mozambique on a monthly basis throughout 2011 (January, April, July, October). The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and stored in GeoJSON and KML formats, representing current food insecurity situations and scenarios.
